module: Flowgraph node "Get Delivery Results" (category provider, delivery). Provides the current results of the delivery as a table (time, timeStr, goalsTotal, goalsCompleted, goalsRequired, goalsRequiredCompleted, allRequiredComplete, vehicleDamages). Outputs: results (nil if no delivery is active) and isActive.

init.desc: Resets results and isActive to nil/false.

_executionStarted.desc: Resets results and isActive to nil/false.

_executionStopped.desc: Resets results and isActive to nil/false.

work.desc: Calls isActive() then getResults() of the freeformDelivery module if the delivery is active.
